title: amazing results on hair
text: Found this shampoo to be gentle and pleasant smelling. Creamy formula leaves hair soft without causing any dryness. Since it's a creamy formula it doesn't cause any hair breakage while washing due to dryness. After using this shampoo, my hair feels really soft, bouncy and shiny to touch. However, my only con with this shampoo is it doesn't magically stop hair fall as it claims. While it does prevent further hair fall and prevents hair breakage and in this way is better than other shampoos but in no way, it would make your hair grow or stop your hair fall at once. But then it's very rare to find a shampoo that can stop hair fall altogether. There are only shampoos that cause more or shampoos that cause less hair fall. For hair fall issue, I have found, serums, lotions, and oils are the best solution as they tend to stay on your scalp for longer to work their magic. So if you're looking for a shampoo that prevents hair fall due to breakage and dryness or one that causes lesser hair fall, go for this one!

title: You're being warned
text: I applied the colour following the instructions to the T, so I am quite astonished by the results. The only part where I can see any colour is the entire area closest to the scalp, which makes me look like a lady greying at the roots who applied mehndi in a misguided attempt to hide her greys. And that's exactly how the colour looks too - bright orange! The rest of my hair is exactly as black as it was before colouring it. It's pretty much a laugh-cry situation at the moment but there won't be any laughs if I can't reverse it using a darker colour before my workday starts. Horribly disappointed at the monumental waste of time and money, so please stay away from it unless you have a surplus of both and a taste for risky business.

Can be worn both for everyday office look or evening party looks.
